customer_acme: Hi team — our client started failing JSON.parse on structured-mode responses after today's deploy. Error: "Unexpected token" at offset 234. Raw response we received:
```json
{"event":"login","user":"bob","note":"Hello\x00world"}
```
We're on API v1, structured_mode=true, streaming=true, client=Node fetch. Any ideas?

jess_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request_id or example prompt? Are you seeing this consistently?

customer_acme: request_id=rq_0a9b2c3d; prompt: "user_login_event" -> schema {event,user,note}. Repro steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"login bob","structured_output":true}' 
2) receive streaming chunks, concat, JSON.parse -> throws
Node: using fetch + response.body.getReader(); happens ~10% of events, appears tied to messages that include emojis or embedded control chars.

mario_sre: Can you include the raw bytes (base64) of the problematic response? stream boundaries may split escape sequences. Also what runtime version? Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: rolled runtime v1.12.3 -> prod at 2026-03-15T02:14:00Z :rocket:

customer_acme: Attached base64: "eyJldmVudCI6ImxvZ2luIiwidXNlciI6ImJvYiIsIm5vdGUiOiJIZWxsbyBcXHgwMDAwd29ybGQifQ==" (that's the raw bytes we captured from the stream)

elaine_ml: We dug in — there's a regression where the structured-output escaping pass is skipped for streaming responses when continuous-batching is enabled. In those cases the model may emit a literal control byte (0x00) instead of the escaped \u0000 sequence, so when clients concatenate chunks they end up with invalid JSON. We've tracked it as BUG-9863. Workaround: disable streaming or enable server-side sanitizer.

jess_support: Quick workaround — send the same request with header "x-rw-sanitize: 1" or include option "sanitize_control_chars": true. That forces the server to escape control chars before emitting chunks.

customer_acme: Tried with x-rw-sanitize: 1 — responses now parse cleanly. Thanks 🙏

mario_sre: Fix merged to main, tests added. Patch rolling: v1.12.4 will roll tonight. Filing internal incident INC-2026-ctrlchars and linking BUG-9863. Please watch for any anomalies and reopen if you see new failures.

jess_support: Thanks — closing this thread. If the issue returns DM me and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
